details.description: Codestral 25.08 (API id codestral-2508) is Mistral AI's code-generation model, released July 30, 2025, built for high-precision fill-in-the-middle (FIM) code completion in production coding assistants and IDEs. It also has a chat mode for instruction-following coding tasks and supersedes the earlier Codestral 25.01 release. Mistral distributes it under a commercial Premier license for cloud, VPC or on-premises deployment.
advantages: Mistral reports +30% more accepted completions and +10% more retained code after a suggestion versus the prior Codestral version.
Mistral reports 50% fewer runaway generations, which it says improves confidence in longer edits.
In chat mode, Mistral reports +5% on instruction following and +5% average improvement in code abilities versus the prior version.
Deployable across cloud, VPC or on-premises infrastructure with no mandatory telemetry and no external API calls for inference or search, per Mistral's announcement.
disadvantages: Distributed under Mistral's commercial Premier license rather than as open weights.
Text and code only; Mistral's model listing does not describe image or vision input support.

notes: Mistral's announcement gives relative improvements over the prior Codestral version (e.g. +30% accepted completions) rather than an absolute accuracy benchmark for codestral-2508 itself, so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed. No page found that restates the context window or output limit independently of the catalog's facts (128,000 / 128,000), so those are left to the catalog. No specific programming-language list was published beyond 'a wide range of languages', so languages is left empty.
